neighbours.label: 'related to' / 'relating to' after a noun, linking it to its subject matter ('complaints related to billing'); peaks on ' related' or on the ' to'. Kinship or predicate 'related' and plain 'about' / 'on' stay quiet.
fire: The helpdesk answers most questions related to passwords and account access.
Our lawyer reviewed every document relating to the sale of the farm.
The archive keeps letters and photographs related to the 1912 strike.
Doctors reported fewer injuries related to cycling after the new lanes opened.
The council postponed all decisions relating to the harbour expansion.
She teaches a short course on legal issues related to online privacy.
The fund covers expenses related to travel and accommodation.
Investigators requested any records relating to the missing shipment.
quiet: The helpdesk answers most questions about passwords and account access.
Our lawyer reviewed every document before the sale of the farm.
My grandmother is related to half the families in the village.
Wolves and coyotes are closely related but rarely interbreed.
The council postponed all decisions on the harbour expansion.
She teaches a short course on online privacy law.
The fund pays for travel and accommodation.
Investigators went to the warehouse to look for the missing shipment.

notes: Card: ' to' x8 (after relating/related), ' related' x7, Spanish/French 'en materia de' / 'en matière de'. Probes: 'related to' 0.41-0.57, 'relating to' 0.24-0.56, 'en materia de' 0.62; kinship 'related to the mayor' 0.05, 'about' 0.08. 'connected to' (0.38) and 'associated with' (0.29) also read, so the pole is wider than the two English phrases tested here; the Romance equivalent is not tested.
